configuration: Release CMake build; model/humanoid/humanoid.xml; mode=derivative; 1 steps; Newton solver; Euler integrator; Dense Jacobian; one CPU core
observable: finite-difference transition and control Jacobians at a fixed articulated state
runtime_note: under 300 s; SAB_STEPS scales the numerical window and SAB_CPUS controls build/run resources
default_vs_upstream: shortened deterministic window preserving the official algorithm family
variant: The first generalized coordinate is changed from 0.0123456789 by exactly two binary64 nextafter steps toward positive infinity; all model, solver, control, and window settings are unchanged.
altbuild: none: the common Release library build is shared across the suite; the forward-dynamics check alone measures the family-wide Debug -O0 floor

comparison.rule: Compare every fixed-identity physical value in observables.bin with |candidate-reference| <= 1.0e-07 + 2.0e-06*|reference|; timing and build metadata are excluded.

evidence.floor_how: Pending selfcheck comparison of the Release nominal solve against the declared Debug -O0 altbuild for forward-dynamics; other checks use that family-wide build evidence.

warrant: The graded values are finite-difference transition and control Jacobians at a fixed articulated state. Their identities are fixed by the pinned MJCF model's named generalized coordinates, bodies, sensors, and contacts. Dropping a force term, changing collision dispatch, weakening solver convergence, or using the wrong integrator moves these arrays well beyond the bound, while the mixed absolute/relative tolerance accommodates ordinary binary64 compiler and platform variation. The two-ULP input variant and the Debug -O0 family check provide calibration evidence without grading timings or storage layout.
